purpose: Benchmark-led admission bands for Triton_AI_Corp models. A class is not an approval to process any data.

benchmark_sources.purpose: Comparable general, coding or agentic capability indices plus price and latency context.
Human-preference signal from blinded pairwise comparisons; not a safety or task-specific quality guarantee.
Reproducible open-model evaluation evidence and disclosed benchmark provenance.
Data-safe representative tasks, deterministic checks, human assessment, latency and actual cost for Triton's intended use.

FLAGSHIP.external_evidence: At least two current independent public signals, including a general-capability or human-preference signal and a task-relevant capability signal. The version must rank in the current top quartile for every relevant signal used.
FLAGSHIP.triton_acceptance: At least 10 representative, data-safe cases; mean quality at least 0.90; no unresolved critical failure; reviewed latency and cost cap.
FLAGSHIP.routing_rule: Use only when complexity or consequence justifies it. Material or sensitive work also needs an approved data route and the applicable human gate.

STANDARD.external_evidence: At least two current independent public signals, including one task-relevant signal. The version must rank in the current top half for every relevant signal used.
STANDARD.triton_acceptance: At least 10 representative, data-safe cases; mean quality at least 0.80; no unresolved critical failure; reviewed latency and cost cap.
STANDARD.routing_rule: Default for non-trivial work once a Worker result needs independent review. It is not a substitute for a Flagship model on high-consequence reasoning.

WORKER.external_evidence: Use a current task-relevant public signal where one exists. General leaderboard rank alone is insufficient for admission.
WORKER.triton_acceptance: At least 10 representative, data-safe cases; mean quality at least 0.75; deterministic checks pass; no autonomous release, safety, legal, architectural, financial, or final quality decision.
WORKER.routing_rule: Use for bounded, reversible work with a concise context capsule. Escalate contradictions, uncertainty, failed checks, or out-of-scope requests to STANDARD or FLAGSHIP.

declared_strengths: image-to-text understanding when the local runtime supports it
declared_limits: not a substitute for a coding specialist
do not use large contexts on the 4 GB laptop GPU
required_next_evidence: measured local latency and VRAM impact

declared_strengths: switchable efficient non-thinking mode for simple tasks
declared_limits: not a substitute for a large coding or reasoning model
thinking mode and long context are unsuitable for routine work on the 4 GB laptop GPU
required_next_evidence: measured local latency and VRAM impact

processing_route_labels.LOCAL_DEVICE_ONLY: The model may originate anywhere, but inference remains on the local device. Model origin is not a data-transfer destination.
processing_route_labels.EU_EEA_APPROVED: Preferred online route after provider, contract, data-processing region, capsule, price cap, and human approval are recorded.
processing_route_labels.US_EXCEPTION: US-hosted route; use only as an approved exception with a minimised data capsule. No model is preselected.
processing_route_labels.CN_EXCEPTION: China-hosted route; use only as an approved exception with a minimised data capsule. No model is preselected.

admission_rule: A candidate needs exact model/version, provider and processing region, benchmark snapshot date and rank denominator, Triton acceptance evidence, allowed data classes, price-card reference, owner, approval record, and rollback route before it is assigned to a class.
